en: Proverbs 16

p.src: 1  The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from the LORD.

en: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from the LORD.
u.src: 1  The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from the LORD.

p.src: 2  All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the motives.

en: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the motives.
u.src: 2  All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the motives.

p.src: 3  Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.

en: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.
u.src: 3  Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.

p.src: 4  The LORD has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

en: The LORD has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.
u.src: 4  The LORD has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

p.src: 5  Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; they shall certainly not be unpunished.

en: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; they shall certainly not be unpunished.
u.src: 5  Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; they shall certainly not be unpunished.

p.src: 6  By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.

en: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.
u.src: 6  By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.

p.src: 7  When a man’s ways please the LORD, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

en: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
u.src: 7  When a man’s ways please the LORD, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

p.src: 8  Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.

en: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
u.src: 8  Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.

p.src: 9  A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.

en: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.
u.src: 9  A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.

p.src: 10  Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.

en: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.
u.src: 10  Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.

p.src: 11  Honest balances and scales are the LORD’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.

en: Honest balances and scales are the LORD’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.
u.src: 11  Honest balances and scales are the LORD’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.

p.src: 12  It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.

en: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.
u.src: 12  It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.

p.src: 13  Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.

en: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.
u.src: 13  Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.

p.src: 14  The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.

en: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.
u.src: 14  The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.

p.src: 15  In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.

en: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.
u.src: 15  In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.

p.src: 16  How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.

en: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
u.src: 16  How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.

p.src: 17  The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.

en: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
u.src: 17  The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.

p.src: 18  Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

en: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
u.src: 18  Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

p.src: 19  It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.

en: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.
u.src: 19  It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.

p.src: 20  He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed.

en: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed.
u.src: 20  He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed.

p.src: 21  The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.

en: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.
u.src: 21  The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.

p.src: 22  Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.

en: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.
u.src: 22  Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.

p.src: 23  The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.

en: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.
u.src: 23  The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.

p.src: 24  Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

en: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
u.src: 24  Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

p.src: 25  There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

en: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
u.src: 25  There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

p.src: 26  The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.

en: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.
u.src: 26  The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.

p.src: 27  A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.

en: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.
u.src: 27  A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.

p.src: 28  A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.

en: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.
u.src: 28  A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.

p.src: 29  A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.

en: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.
u.src: 29  A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.

p.src: 30  One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.

en: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.
u.src: 30  One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.

p.src: 31  Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

en: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
u.src: 31  Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

p.src: 32  One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

en: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
u.src: 32  One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

p.src: 33  The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.

en: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.
u.src: 33  The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.
